scope: Manual browser interaction with a standalone synthetic UX prototype; not production acceptance or a security test.
browser: Codex in-app browser, CUA tab 23; served on loopback port 4388
observed_passes: Shelf opens three sample works; title search filters and clearing restores results.
Team folder shows its report; opening the report shows saved v3 and linked v2.
Sharing panel switches audience; invited recipient without access sees a neutral page without work title.
Explicit update changes the linked version to v3; recipient sees the updated demo values.
History opens version 2 with a persistent notice and a return to current version control.
Revoking the demo link displays the unavailable-link recipient state.
Mobile shelf, work and sharing panel render at 390 CSS px without page overflow.
At 320 x 740 the panel fits within the viewport and its action footer remains visible.
Escape closes the share dialog and returns focus to the Share control.
At 768 CSS px shelf and long-title demo have no horizontal page overflow.
Adding a named example from the HTML dialog produces a private v1 demo without executing supplied HTML.
Final 1280 x 900 shelf has matching viewport and document widths of 1280.
Browser error log query after final version/revoke interactions returned no entries.
limitations: All state is synthetic and in memory; reload resets it.
No real upload, invitation, authorization, public link, TTL enforcement, search crawler or server was tested.
Not a full accessibility audit or a test with real users.
Viewport overrides were reset after testing.
Screenshots reflect their recorded moments; they are not production render baselines.
